items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Leslie was in my first big band.

ctx.x: those area bookers. Like I'm a booking agent, maybe somebody would contact me and say I would like you to work the tri-state area, or something like that. Well, Leslie had been to New York State with Trent and came back--now, he was one of those youngsters that I admired so. When I came back I hit on Leslie again--I'll show you the pictures I have--Leslie was in my first big band. And so, Leslie said yes and so when we got to going pretty good he said, did you want to go back east? I said yeah. He said well,…
